items.name: cta-anim-001
items.title: Призыв к действию с дыханием
items.description: Полноценная секция призыва к действию: заголовок и кнопки по центру, за ними — мягкое радиальное свечение, которое дышит по яркости и масштабу, а сам контент въезжает снизу вверх с лёгким стаггером при появлении.
items.docs: Секция самодостаточна: один файл, ноль зависимостей, палитра в локальных --vibeui-cta-anim-001-*. Тему берёт из окружения через light-dark() плюс строку для класса .dark. container-type делает блок собственным query-контейнером: кегль заголовка считается в cqi от ширины блока. Фоновое свечение — размытый радиальный градиент за контентом, дышит по opacity и scale в бесконечном цикле. Заголовок, подтекст и кнопки появляются fade+rise с нарастающей задержкой при монтировании секции. Всё гаснет при prefers-reduced-motion.

en.title: Breathing call to action
en.description: A full call-to-action section: a heading and buttons centered on the page, backed by a soft radial glow that breathes in brightness and scale, with the content rising in with a slight stagger on appearance.
en.docs: The section is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, palette in local --vibeui-cta-anim-001-* variables. It takes the theme from the environment via light-dark() plus a rule for the .dark class. container-type makes the block its own query container: the heading size is computed in cqi from the block's width. The background glow is a blurred radial gradient behind the content that breathes in opacity and scale in an infinite loop. The heading, subtext and buttons fade+rise in with an increasing delay when the section mounts. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.summary: A full-width call-to-action section: a heading and one or two buttons centered on the page, backed by a breathing radial glow, with content rising in on appearance. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-cta-anim-001-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the breathing background glow in brightness and scale — the section's signature
the fade+rise entrance of heading, subtext and buttons with a stagger
container-type:inline-size on the root and clamp()/cqi sizes — layout must not depend on window width
the .dark class rule: without it the section stays light on a dark page in another project
the prefers-reduced-motion rule that disables the animations
adapt: primaryAction and secondaryAction: labels and links
the accent color via the accent prop to match your brand
glow — turns off the breathing glow, leaving a flat background
notes: glow={false} removes the glow and its animation, the rest of the content still fades+rises in
the section is its own container (container-type:inline-size), so it can be placed in a narrow column without losing the design
